The main takeaway from our work is that

we have found that the two major receptors of the blood-brain barrier endothelium, pIgR (polymeric immunoglobulin G receptor) and PECAM1 (Platelet Endothelial Cell Adhesion Molecule), bind to the pneumococci adhesins PspC and RrgA.
the BBB endothelial receptors pIgR, and PECAM1, are potential therapeutic targets to prevent pneumococcus from crossing the BBB and causing meningitis.
